descriptions.notStarted: According to #p1101002#, I can take my Knighthood Exam if I see #b#p1101005##k, the Chief Knight of the Wind. I better head over to Ereve and meet #p1101005#.
descriptions.inProgress: The Knighthood Exam has started. The test itself is actually quite simple. I just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, and defeat the Mimis inside while bringing back #t4032098#. I better find #b30 #t4032098#s#k and bring them back to #p1101005# \n\n#i4032098# #t4032098# #b#c4032098# / 30#k
descriptions.completed: I have successfully completed the Knighthood Exam and officially dropped the "in-Training" from my title. As a bonafide Cygnus Knight, I shall do my best to remain level-headed.
